title: IZAKA-YA public lending wallet
notes: Current first-party service page presents an active crypto lending function and states a normal public surface of up to 12% APY, daily interest, and lending periods from one day to one year. Used for current status and product-surface evidence only.

title: IZAKA-YA company profile
notes: First-party company page identifies Izakaya Limited, a Hong Kong operating address, company establishment on 2023-04-14, and a December 2023 service-start month. CYA does not invent an exact launch day from the month-only service-start statement.

title: IZAKA-YA lending procedure
notes: Official support instructions describe logged-in wallet balance, lending amount and period selection, estimated-interest review, contract-content confirmation, and automatic credit of principal plus interest to the wallet after the lock period. Product mechanics are not proof of universal realized repayment.

title: How do I start lending?
notes: First-party English support page describes depositing cryptocurrency to the IZAKA-YA wallet, selecting lending amount and period, and receiving interest from IZAKA-YA periodically. Used to corroborate current lending-product mechanics.

title: IZAKA-YA Terms and Conditions
notes: Current public website terms state Cayman Islands governing law but are generic website terms rather than complete lending-product terms. They do not independently resolve the lending counterparty, customer asset ownership transfer, custody deployment, bankruptcy treatment, insurance, or regulatory authorization.

title: Earn 33% APY with the IZAKA-YA 33 Festival
notes: Issuer campaign page advertised 33% APY for supported cryptocurrencies on a three-day lending term during June 2026. Preserved as an advertised promotional term, not verified realized customer yield.

title: IZAKA-YA first-time lending 500% campaign
notes: Issuer campaign page advertised an additional reward calculated at 500% APR for first-time lending, subject to eligibility, KYC/application requirements and a 10,000-yen-equivalent USDT reward cap. This is an advertised campaign formula, not verified realized customer return.

title: IZAKA-YA 1000% switching campaign
notes: Issuer campaign page advertised total rewards equivalent to 1000% APR for an initial three-day lending step after transferring assets from another exchange or wallet, with eligibility conditions and a 15,000-yen-equivalent USDT cap. Used only to establish the advertised campaign event and conditions.

title: 30-Day Lending 100 Festival
notes: Issuer campaign page advertised a temporary 100% annualized yield for new 30-day lending contracts from July 20 through July 24, 2026, while describing 12% as the normal 30-day rate. Preserved as advertised campaign terms only.

title: What Services Does Ledn Offer?
notes: Current first-party help article lists Ledn Growth Accounts, Transaction Accounts, DCNs, Trade, Dollar Loans and B2X Loans and states that Growth Accounts earn interest on USDC and USDT. Added as the Phase 10 mature-corpus maintenance item to bring Ledn to three reviewed evidence records.
